note: N. 4010.0 ± .3 in from the base centre, §64, the same point as 524.1 ± .3 in S. of the N. base edge. §35 gives that 524.1 ± .3 in, the probable error being that of fixing the length of the sides.
mid. 287.0 ± .8 in E. of the centre, §64; stated the same in §35, which adds 3723.6 in from the E. side and 4297.6 in from the W. side at that level.
+668.2 ± .1 in above the pavement, §64 and §35, reduced to the true beginning of the floor and not to the present broken entrance.
N. 306. ± 2. in, §64, with 4228. ± 2. in from the N. base edge. §36 derives it as 524.1 + 3704.3 = 4228 ± 2? or 306 N. from the mid-plane, with Petrie's own query mark and no ± on the 306.
mid. 286.4 ± 1. in E., §64. §36 derives it as 287.0 − [sin(3′55″ − 3′44″) × 3704] − .4 difference of offsets = 286.4 ± 1.0.
−1181. ± 1. in, §64. §36 derives it as 668.2 − (4140 × sin 26°31′23″) − .8 difference of floor offsets = −1181 ± 1?, with Petrie's own query mark.

mid. 286.3 ± 1. in E., §64; the same figure stands in §37's table, where the mid of the passage is read as an offset W. of the entrance axis continued, which runs at 286.8 E.

−1178. ± 1. in, §64. §37 tabulates roofs rather than floors: the roof of the horizontal passage at −1143 (top +38.3 above the entrance passage floor end) less the 35.5 E. and 36.0 W. height gives −1178.8.
S. 203. ± 2. in, §64, with 4737. ± 2. in from the N. base edge; the mid of §37's N. wall at 40 S. and S. wall at 366 S.
mid. 25.9 ± 2. in E., §64. §37's wall distances give (302.9 − 250.6)/2 = 26.2 at the N. wall and (299.6 − 254.5)/2 = 22.6 at the S. wall, mean 24.4, so §64's 25.9 is not simply their mean.

−1056. ± 2. in, §64, which is the roof and not the floor: §37 gives the large chamber top at +125.3 above the entrance passage floor end, its note 4 adding +124.3 at the N. doorway and 125.4 to 127.6 at the S. S. 366. ± 2. in, §64, with 4900. ± 2. in from the N. base edge; the large chamber's S. wall in §37.
mid. 284.9 ± 1. in E., §64, as in §37's table, 1.9 W. of the entrance axis continued.

mid. 277.1 in E., §64, as in §37's table, 9.7 W. of the entrance axis continued. No error stated in either place.
